0022600021.text: The Houston Rockets (5-0, first in the Southwest and the West, on a five-game win streak) visit the Dallas Mavericks (2-2, fourth in the Southwest and 2.5 games back, ninth in the West) for Houston's sixth game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup. Houston is missing Alperen Sengun (back soreness), Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The Rockets lead this season's series 1-0 after a 128-110 win in Houston on October 21, 2026, and the two teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
